name: request_rollback
description:
Roll back a project's production traffic to a previous production deployment, identified by deploymentId. The optional description input records the reason for the rollback.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/projects/{projectId}/rollback/{deploymentId} --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

deploymentId.description: The ID of the deployment to rollback *to*

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
